summary: BTC ~$76.7k, -1.4% in 24h, slipped under $77k with >$100M of longs liquidated in an hour ahead of Tuesday's US midterms. Longest streak of daily net realised losses since mid-August; ETF outflows continue ($643M on Oct 30). Support $76.0-76.6k then $75k. Offsets: Strategy bought 811 BTC and Strive 124 BTC last week. Mercado Bitcoin (~$40M) hack adds to exchange-safety worries.
